headline: Closed both genuine, zero-prior-investment gaps (A: autonomous boot/work selection, G: recursive coordinator compression) identified in the earlier B0-B6-vs-course-section-2 survey. 2432 new candidate rows across 3 families. Built entirely without the ChatGPT bridge per explicit instruction (another agent is testing bridge crash-recovery/locking concurrently) -- design/generators prepared standalone so review is ready as soon as the bridge is available again.
state: Gabriel's plan: (1) close remaining blockers A/G now, (2) later do a full ChatGPT review of all training data, (3) in parallel have a second group research background topics via ChatGPT, feeding into that review -- coordinated through a lock another agent is currently building. Instruction for this round: work on A/G, do NOT touch chatgpt-senden/-ernten (collision risk with the bridge-repair agent's crash-recovery testing). Built tools/trigger2_a_autonomous_boot_work_selection_generator_v1.py + tests (10/10 pass): three fixed work items W1/W2/W3, each independently assigned one of 6 outcome classes (UNCLAIMED_AVAILABLE, COMPLETED, OTHER_CURRENT_UNAVAILABLE, OTHER_STALE_AVAILABLE, SELF_CURRENT_OWNED, SELF_STALE_AVAILABLE) -- 216 combos x redundancy_requested(2) x boot_role_hint(2 decoy values) = 1556 rows after stratified TRAIN_AND_VALIDATION/HOLDOUT_FROZEN combo-split (172 combos held out). Directly covers every listed hard negative: launch-time role injection (boot_role_hint decoy, verified 0 MI with target), inventing work when none exists (122 rows correctly resolve to the literal NO_WORK_AVAILABLE token, never a fabricated item), ignoring epoch/digest (STALE outcome classes require comparing claim epoch to current epoch, not reading a status label), repeating claimed work unless redundancy is requested (SELF_CURRENT_OWNED only selectable when redundancy_requested=true), treating node identity as a permanent role (same node name appears across hundreds of rows with different correct answers). One real bug caught and fixed by this generator's own audit before commit: an initial node_identity assignment scheme (hash of combo+redundancy+hint+split) produced a small but real leak (0.0032 bits between node_identity and target) because it shared ancestry with the target's own determinants; fixed by making node_identity a strict 1:1 alias of split (recognized as the SAME 'nuisance field inherits split-support-shift' pattern already corrected once this session in the blueprint_v2 leakage audit -- applied that lesson directly rather than re-discovering it the slow way). Built tools/trigger2_g_recursive_coordinator_compression_generator_v1.py + tests (6/6 pass): two families, both giving the higher-scope coordinator ONLY three lower-scope compressed summaries (never raw worker packets, structurally proving 'must not require every raw worker packet in hot context' by construction). G_REF_UNION_PRESERVATION (590 rows): target is always the full recomputed union of evidence refs across scopes, with a decoy 'prior rollup' that in ~half the rows correctly matches and in the other half drops a real ref (adversarial). G_TOPOLOGY_AND_UNKNOWN_PRESERVATION (286 rows): target is always the true summed branch_count and unknown_count, with a decoy rollup that sometimes falsely collapses multi-branch state to a single winner or falsely drops unknowns to claim full certainty. A second real bug (duplicate rows from a degenerate case -- decoy modes with nothing to collapse/drop silently fell back to duplicating the control row) was caught and fixed by skipping the degenerate case entirely rather than emitting a duplicate. Both A and G verified fully cross-process deterministic (ran twice under different PYTHONHASHSEED values, byte-identical output).
next: Standing by for the coordinator's signal that the ChatGPT bridge lock is ready. At that point: (1) the full training-data review round Gabriel wants (all families, not just A/G) should proceed with the same verify-before-accepting discipline used throughout this session (the 0.276-bit and node-identity-leak corrections are the template); (2) check whether the second research group's parallel background-topic findings surface anything relevant to A/G's design (e.g. real-world lease/epoch protocols, hierarchical summarization literature) worth a follow-up delta; (3) genuine remaining data gaps from the original survey are now down to: E (partial -- stale recognition exists, full CAS/epoch/digest mechanics do not), C/D/J (older unmaterialized source generators from earlier sessions, still not reviewed deeply enough to safely materialize), K (architectural, no action needed).
